scope.task: Understand how cluster resources relate without implying runtime network truth
scope.primary_action: Select a resource node or relationship and inspect its evidence
scope.consequence: Read-only inspection; no cluster mutation or sensitive payload reveal

verification.method: Inspect screenshot and accessibility tree at the minimum supported app size
verification.expected: Scope and completeness precede the map; selecting a node reveals safe facts without hiding context
verification.result: The map exposes 15 nodes, 31 relationships, evidence legend, snapshot status, and selected-item inspector without header wrapping.

verification.expected: The inspector marks internals unavailable and invents no physical or provider resources
verification.result: The inspector states that provider-managed internals may not be exposed and that visibility is not exposed by the cluster API.

verification.method: Select a relationship row and press Down
verification.expected: Selection and inspector advance together using only the keyboard
verification.result: The selected row advanced to the declared Ingress-to-Service relationship and exposed source field, join rule, assumption, and portName https.

verification.method: Render a fixture where NetworkPolicy listing returns Forbidden
verification.expected: The denied input is named while readable topology remains usable and is never labeled complete
verification.result: The banner names networkpolicies as access denied, marks the snapshot partial, and retains 14 nodes and 28 relationships without a stuck refresh indicator.
